Pictorial map. Covers Jiangnan, Jiangxi, Huguang, Henan in central China,. Shows distribution of salt industry and trade in the four provinces. Relief shown pictorially. Title supplied. Pen-and-ink and watercolor. Oriented with north to the bottom. Imperfect: torn at right. "Shanzhou quan tu" on verso. English translation: Map of two Huai salt fields and transpotation in four provinces. Includes text which explains the quota of salt allowed in each county, and describes the waterways and land routes for salt transportation to each province.
